en: Matiaaa!!

jp: ちょっと落ち着けってカイン！！
いったい、どうしたんだよ？
en: Hey, calm down, Cain!! What on earth is wrong with you?

jp: マティアの歌声が聞こえるんだ！
エクサルには聞こえないの！？
en: I can hear Matia singing! Can't you hear it, Exal!?

jp: そんなもの何も・・・
en: Singing? I don't hear any...

jp: いいえ、僕らにも聞こえます
en: No, we can hear it too. Matia-san is definitely here.

jp: それに・・周囲をよく見て下さい
en: Besides... take a good look around you.

jp: みなさんは気づきましたか？
en: Haven't you all noticed what's strange about this facility?

jp: この建物に何かあるっていうの？
en: What's this, all of a sudden? Something about this building?

jp: これは建物なんかじゃない・・
強大な、生きている木なんだ！
en: This isn't a building at all... It's a huge, living tree!

jp: 何故か分からないけど、
この木から伝わってくるんです
en: I don't know why, but Matia-san's voice is coming through this tree.

jp: 支えられているらしいな
en: It seems this building is supported by the World Tree.

jp: いや・・・正確に言えば、
この街全体が世界樹の上に
建てられているようだ
en: No... to be precise, this whole city appears to be built atop the World Tree.

jp: ど、どうするんですかっ！？
en: Th-then what about the city!? Wh-what do we do!?

jp: 急速に枯れはじめています
このまま進行すれば・・・！
en: This World Tree is now withering rapidly. If it goes on like this...!

jp: うむ、サンバルテルミを含む
世界樹もろとも崩壊するだろう
en: Yes. This whole city, San Bartelmi included, will collapse with the World Tree.

jp: うわあぁぁぁぁぁぁっっ！！
en: Uwaaaaaaaah!!
Is everyone all right!?
Hm... Kilota? What's wrong, are you all right!?
Ugh... Uuh.

jp: たくさん・・声があふれてる
en: Lilis feels sick. So many... voices, flooding in.

jp: あの木からたくさん・・
何かが・・・入ってくるの
en: From that tree, so much... something's... coming in.

jp: ものすごく・・多くの声が
無理矢理頭の中に入り込むようで
en: So... so many voices, like they're forcing their way into my head. It's sickening...
Voices? ....I see.

jp: 辺り一帯を覆う世界樹をかいして
en: Someone's voice is being sent out through the World Tree that spans this whole area.

jp: それを、インセストたる
自然に感じ取ってしまうのだ
en: And as Incests, Kilota and Lilis can't help but pick it up naturally.

jp: 彼らをここまで苦しめる声とは、
en: But what voice could torment them this badly...?

jp: ヨハネ・・どうしよう
マティアの歌が、たくさんの声に
かき消されて聞こえないよ
en: Johannes... what do I do? All those voices drown out Matia's song. I can't hear it.

jp: カイン、お前にも彼らと同じ声が
聞こえるというのか・・・？！
en: What...? Cain, you can hear the same voices they do...?!

jp: マティアっ、どこにいるの？！
en: Matia, where are you!?

jp: 聞こえるかもしれない！
en: Cain, calm down! ...You, of all people, might be able to hear it!

jp: これは音ではない、思念だ
en: This is not sound. It is thought.

jp: 心に直接訴えかける想いを
お前なら感じ取れるハズだ
en: A feeling that speaks straight to the heart. You should be able to sense it.

jp: そんなこと言われても
ボクにはわからないよッ！！
en: You say that, but I don't know how!!

jp: 周囲の音に囚われないよう・・
お前なら、聞こえるハズだ！
en: Cover your ears. Don't be caught by the sounds around you... You should hear it!
Cover my ears...

jp: マティアの歌声が分かるよ！
en: It's true, I can hear it!! I can make out Matia's singing! But... how?
As I thought...

jp: 地面の下・・もっと深いところ
そこに、マティアがいる！
en: Underground... somewhere much deeper. That's where Matia is!

jp: とうとう・・＜その時＞が・・
en: So for Cain too, at last... that time has come...

jp: 歌声がみちびく場所で
マティアがお前を待っている
en: Let us go, Cain. Where the song leads, Matia is waiting for you.
Yeah!!

jp: へぇ、インセストってヤツは
en: Well, well. These Incests sure are handy.
What...!
That voice...

jp: パスカを使ってしらみつぶしに
嬢ちゃんを捜そうと思ったが、
en: I meant to have the Pasca hunt down the little lady. You've saved me the trouble.
Aragi!!
Seems you and I are bound by some stubborn fate.

jp: 肝心な時には・・ヘッ
en: At every crucial moment... heh. You always show your faces.

jp: 最初にあの嬢ちゃんと会った時も
en: Come to think of it, you were there the first time I met the little lady too.
Eh... mister irregular angel?

jp: これってなぁ、本当に偶然か？
en: Tell me, is that really a coincidence?
Aragi!!

jp: 貴様とのクサレ縁など
ここで断ち切ってやる！！
en: Fight me! I'll sever this cursed bond with you right here!!

jp: そうカリカリするなよザイオン
お前らへの手みやげだって
ちゃんと用意してあるんだぜ？
en: Don't get so worked up, Zion. I've brought a little present for you lot, see?
You all... go play with these guys!

jp: ギシャアアアアアアッ！！
en: GSHAAAAAAAA!!
Tch!!

jp: ヒィーヤッハッハッハ！！
en: HYAA-HAHAHA!! Soon. It'll all be settled soon!!

jp: やってやるよ・・・アラギ
アンタとの決着をつけるまでは、
en: Bring it on... Aragi. I can't die until I've settled things with you!!

jp: ギシャァァァァァァァ！！！
en: GSHAAAAAAAA!!

jp: いったい何匹出てくれば
en: Ugh, one after another!! How many of you are going to crawl out of there!!

jp: いつまでたっても先へ進めません
en: At this rate we'll never get any further.

jp: マティアを助けるどころか、
俺たちまで生き埋めになっちまう
en: Damn it! At this rate, forget saving Matia, we'll end up buried alive ourselves!
Argh, damn you!!
KSHAAAAAAA!!
Cain!!

jp: 行ってマティアを助けるんだ！！
en: You go on ahead! Go and save Matia!!
Got it!!
But, everyone...!!
Yeah... got it!

jp: へへっ、死ぬんじゃねーぞ！
en: Heh heh. Don't you go dying on us!

jp: このまま先に進むのは無理だ、
お前はいったん外へ出て、
en: No way through from here. Get back outside and head straight down below.
Zion.
GSHAAAAAAAA
Tch!!
Get going, Cain.

jp: 二人とも・・・ありがとう
en: Thank you... both of you.

jp: ここを片付けたらすぐにでも
アラギを追っていくわ
en: Don't get the wrong idea. Once we've cleaned up here, we're going right after Aragi.
Yeah!! I'll be waiting!!

jp: 行くことなんか出来ないよ！！
en: But I can't just leave everyone behind!!
Cain-san!! Behind you!

jp: ギシャァァァァァァァ！！！
en: GSHAAAAAAAA!!
Young man
Bonjour
Cain
